description: R08 functional closeout cohort for the remaining portable VtIo live-buffer mutations, legacy host selection semantics, and the complete Microsoft ReflowTests.cpp data-driven corpus. The Rust owners now mutate real Rust screen/text state and replay Microsoft vectors directly rather than certifying serialization-only surrogates.

entries.notes: VtScreenOutputState now owns the live cell mutation plus VT projection, including zero-count and PowerShell clear-shim behavior, and reproduces Microsoft's exact affected-cell vectors.
The same live-state owner preserves DBCS leading/trailing bookkeeping while replacing attributes and reproduces Microsoft's wide-cell vector.
The Rust owner mutates glyph state, preserves destination attributes, handles wide-glyph row boundaries and the full-buffer clear optimization, then emits the exact Microsoft VT vectors.
The scroll owner reproduces Microsoft's clipping/fill/source-target mutations, exact VT bytes, no-op/clear cases and final live screen grid.
The DECCRA path uses the same live screen state and reproduces Microsoft's rectangular-copy/fill vectors and final grid exactly.
The live-state owner mutates attributes across row boundaries while preserving wide-cell flags and reproduces the exact Microsoft writer transaction.
The Rust owner mutates characters in the live screen state, preserves attributes, handles truncation and wide glyph boundaries, and reproduces all Microsoft vectors.
The portable legacy-selection owner reproduces Microsoft's box-mode span matrix directly over Rust TextBuffer state.
The portable legacy-selection owner reproduces Microsoft's line/alternate-mode span matrix including single-line anchor permutations.
Rust reproduces the complete Microsoft forward word-selection walk through the real Rust buffer to its terminal endpoint.
Rust reproduces Microsoft's complete reverse word-selection walk and exact stopping points.

The integration witness parses a byte-for-byte copy of Microsoft's ReflowTests.cpp fixture and replays all 15 scenarios step-by-step through the cursor-aware Rust reflow owner, checking dimensions, cursor, wrap flags, glyphs and DBCS state.
